Task: Quenching of Copper
Description: Simulate the quenching process of Copper using LAMMPS by cooling its molten structure under NPT conditions, followed by relaxation under NPT and NVT conditions. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential and the given simulation parameters. Report the final density of the system in g/cm³.

numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)

{"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/quenching/brief/tasks/copper_quenching_trial_4/quench.in", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for Cu quenching

units           metal
atom_style      atomic
boundary        p p p

read_data       /structures/task_29/heatedsystem_3000_reax.dat

# EAM potential for Cu
pair_style      eam
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/Cu_u3.eam

# Energy minimization
minimize        1.0e-4 1.0e-6 1000 10000

# Initialize velocities
velocity        all create 2000 12345 dist gaussian

# NPT quench from 2000K to 300K
fix             1 all npt temp 2000 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
timestep        0.001
thermo          100
thermo_style    custom step temp press vol density pe ke etotal
dump            1 all custom 1000 dump.quench id type x y z
run             20000
undump          1
unfix           1

# NPT relaxation at 300K
fix             2 all npt temp 300 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run             10000
unfix           2

# NVT relaxation at 300K
fix             3 all nvt temp 300 300 0.1
run             10000
unfix           3

# Output final density
variable        mass equal "mass(all)"
variable        volume equal "vol"
variable        density equal "v_mass/v_volume*16.6053904"
print          "Final_density: ${density}""}
